collections.name: WELLINGTON
collections.title: Two colours. A classical conversation.
collections.tagline: Navy & burgundy. Piano lacquer. Fine gold.
collections.description: Fifteen MARINER living-room references form an open exhibition in navy and burgundy. Distinct upholstered families meet crisp black-and-white lacquer, geometric medallions, gilded foliage and curved white stretchers. Six-leg round and four-leg square tables, two consoles and mirrors, a glazed cabinet and a media piece complete the collection. Concealed construction and calibrated materials remain visual interpretations.
